allReviewerFindings.exactClaim: Real process overflow handling and service oversized-string handling are proven independently, but the complete oversized child stdout through service rejection and downstream suppression is not proven.

allReviewerFindings.exactClaim: spawn without an explicit env inherits the parent environment and may expose Factory secrets to the configured Codebase Memory executable.
allReviewerFindings.requiredAction: Identify required child variables, then pass an explicit minimal environment; never inherit the full Factory environment by default.

allReviewerFindings.exactClaim: stderr is piped but never consumed, and timeout/cancellation leaves the child running.
allReviewerFindings.requiredAction: Make stderr non-blocking and bounded or explicitly ignored, and add deterministic timeout/overflow lifecycle proof while preserving shared-request cancellation isolation.

allReviewerFindings.exactClaim: getIndexStatus ignores its signal and shared index work can return an uncancellable existing promise; transport cancellation removes a pending request but leaves shared child work running.
allReviewerFindings.requiredAction: Honor status cancellation and isolate shared index callers without killing unrelated requests; document and test orphan-response handling.

allReviewerFindings.exactClaim: Normalized external output and source excerpts may be persisted to caches/metadata before output-time redaction.
allReviewerFindings.requiredAction: Apply the established bounded redaction policy before cache/metadata persistence or prove an equivalent protected-storage boundary with synthetic secret tests.

allReviewerFindings.exactClaim: Generic tooling expects serialized executor results while typed integration ports return parsed DTOs.
allReviewerFindings.requiredAction: Prove the intended typed serializer binding from parsed service DTO to serialized ToolResult input; do not redesign the already coherent Promise<string> transport contract without evidence.

allReviewerFindings.exactClaim: No evidence traces a real Codebase Memory process response through generic tooling dispatch.
allReviewerFindings.requiredAction: Add the smallest composition test covering valid and oversized process output through service serialization and registered output validation.

allReviewerFindings.exactClaim: Service excerpt truncation can split a multibyte UTF-8 character despite raw transport byte safety.
allReviewerFindings.requiredAction: Use code-point-safe byte truncation at the service excerpt boundary and add a multibyte normalization assertion.
